mil7.8.6:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, bhojanassa tīṇi angāni gahetabbānīti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni tīṇi angāni gahetabbānīti. -
mil7.8.6:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena sabbasattānaṃ maggupatthambhena bhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.8.6:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja bhojanassa paṭhamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.8.6:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja bhojanaṃ sattānaṃ balaṃ vaḍḍheti,
mil7.8.6:2.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena puññavaḍḍhiyā vaḍḍhitabbaṃ.
mil7.8.6:2.3: Idaṃ mahārāja bhojanassa dutiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.8.6:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja bhojanaṃ sabbasattānaṃ abhipatthitaṃ,
mil7.8.6:3.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena sabbalokābhipatthitena bhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.8.6:3.3: Idaṃ mahārāja bhojanassa tatiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
